Summary: Validates the response from the main endpoint, ensuring the API returns the expected status and JSON content.

Args:
    None

Returns:
    void: Indicates the response was successfully validated with the expected status code and JSON content.

Description: This function is used to perform a basic integration test on the main endpoint of the API. It sends a GET request to the root URL and asserts that the response has a status code of 200 and the expected JSON payload.
